feeds.title: Subversive Femme » Vintage Knitting
feeds.description: Welcome to Subversive Femme! I'm Bex and I love sharing my vintage knitting and sewing life with you. I hope you enjoy the hundreds of free vintage knitting patterns that I've shared. It is the inspiration for those who are just dipping in their toe, and connecting with those who live their passion everyday.

feeds.title: Killer Kitsch Designs » Knitting
feeds.description: If you love all things vintage, you will love this page. Killer Kitsch is all about fashions from 1900 to 1950s, including knitting patterns, vintage sewing and information on where to find vintage resources and news.

feeds.title: The Vintage Pattern Files
feeds.description: The Vintage Pattern Files is the attempt to create an on-line link archive of all the wonderful FREE vintage patterns and tutorials lurking on the web. The aim is to make finding the perfect pattern is as easy as pie!
